Chapter III · Our Wedding Rituals
Sacred Wedding Traditions

Seven Sacred Steps.
One Lifetime Together.

“From sacred promises to the tying of the Mangalsutra, every ritual marks a beautiful step into our life together.”

🪔
Ganesh PujaSeeking divine blessings for an auspicious beginning and a joyful married life.
🌿
Jeelakarra BellamThe sacred Telugu ritual where the bride and groom place cumin and jaggery on each other, symbolising an inseparable bond.
💛
Mangalya DharanamThe sacred tying of the Mangalsutra, symbolising the cherished bond of marriage and lifelong togetherness.
🌾
TalambraluA joyful shower of rice and pearls symbolising prosperity, abundance, happiness and mutual love.
👣
Saptapadi · Seven Sacred StepsSeven steps around the sacred fire, representing seven promises to walk through life together with love, strength and understanding.
⭐
Arundhati NakshatramLooking towards the sacred Arundhati star, a symbol of devotion, harmony and an enduring partnership.
🙏
Ashirvadam · Family BlessingsReceiving the blessings of elders as two families come together and a new chapter begins.
Seven sacred steps. Endless promises. One beautiful forever. ✦
